node.title: Re^3: Parsing Problems
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Has something changed with package, lib, eval, or qq~?

I'm not certain, but there may have been small changes to how [doc://eval] handles Unicode, but [doc://evalbytes] was introduced in 5.16, so before the 5.18 that you're migrating away from. Other than that, based on this little piece of code, I don't see anything that might be different between the two versions. And whether something has changed with [mod://Text::Unaccent::PurePerl], you'd have to check what version you have installed in both environments (perl -MText::Unaccent::PurePerl -le 'print $Text::Unaccent::PurePerl::VERSION').

If you think you're having trouble with [doc://eval], then it's best if you built its argument first, stored it in a variable, used [doc://Data::Dumper] or [mod://Data::Dump] to show it, and also check [doc://eval] for errors using the pattern eval "...; 1" or die "eval failed: $@" (see [id://1153468]). (Update before posting: I see [haj] [id://1233720|made] a similar point.)

However, I would strongly recommend against using [doc://eval] in the first place, building Perl code from strings and trying to run it can be quite brittle, and in many cases even a major security risk. If you were to show more context (SSCCE), we could most likely suggest an alternative without [doc://eval] (Update: [id://11100044|Yep!]).
